item.title: Enclosures & Prototyping (Mechanical)
item.description:
Mechanical Design & Physical Assembly

How you bridge the gap between electronics and physical products. Importing Altium STEP files into Fusion 360, rendering, 3D printing (FDM/SLA) prototypes, component hand-soldering, and final assembly stress tests.
